facts: The latest Claude Code changelog version is 2.1.289 (2026-10-03). Versions 2.1.285-2.1.289 keep fixing individual Bash deny/ask parse gaps: env-var prefix and bare assignment under sandbox auto-allow, nested compound commands, BASHPID arithmetic, rm with a ~ or wildcard redirect, rm inside bash -c, and writes through repo-committed symlinks.

Sonnet 5.5 migration guide: tool_choice any/tool returns 400, including on the token counting endpoint. thinking disabled returns 400; the replacement is between_tools, which itself returns 400 at xhigh/max, with extra fields, or with a mid-conversation effort change. On Bedrock, strict tool use and structured outputs are not available for Sonnet 5.5.

Sonnet 5.5 server-side fallback (fallbacks:'default', beta header server-side-fallback-2026-07-01, Claude API only) retries only cyber and frontier_llm refusals on Sonnet 5. bio, reasoning_extraction and general_harms are not retried. The official route for legitimate security work is the Cyber Verification Program; SDK BetaRefusalFallbackMiddleware does client-side retry on Bedrock/Google Cloud/Foundry.

Mods admin doc: sec-default@builtin guard loads only with managed settings or Team/Enterprise sign-in. Controls: allowManagedModsOnly (managed settings only), disableSideloadFlags, allowManagedHooksOnly, disableAllHooks, policy mod in prependPlugins. A policy mod's plugin.register check fails open without a .catch handler. CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is ignored from v2.1.287.

Permission-modes doc: from v2.1.283, auto is the built-in starting mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions on every plan and provider; permissions.defaultMode in managed settings overrides; permissions.disableAutoMode:'disable' removes auto entirely. VS Code extension does not read project settings for the starting mode.

Memory doc: under claude-md-or-agents-md (default), AGENTS.md is read only when no CLAUDE.md/.claude/CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md exists in the working directory or above. instructionFiles under pluginConfigs.agents-md@builtin is ignored in project/local settings. @AGENTS.md import inside CLAUDE.md works in every session. Before 2.1.281, Bedrock and telemetry-off sessions read CLAUDE.md only.
Issues #98376, #95833, #99259 and #98416 were open with no maintainer response or workaround when fetched on 2026-10-05.
arXiv 2609.37315 releases code/contracts/data at github.com/rohithreddybc/tool-contract-conformance. arXiv 2610.03237 (decision pins) does not say whether code is released.
